# Photoupscale.online

> Free AI image upscaler that processes photos and illustrations locally in a web browser. No account or watermark. English and Czech interfaces.

Photoupscale.online enlarges JPG, PNG and WebP images by 2× or 4× and exports PNG or JPEG. It is a browser application, not a server-side image-processing API. User-selected image pixels are not uploaded to a processing server. An internet connection is needed initially to load the application and AI assets.

## Pages

- [English image upscaler](https://photoupscale.online/): The application, with photo noise reduction, crop comparisons, batch exports and print-size settings.
- [Image upscaling guide and FAQ](https://photoupscale.online/info/): How to choose a model, upscale photos, preserve transparency, process a batch, and understand pixels versus print DPI.
- [Czech image upscaler](https://photoupscale.online/cs/): Czech interface for the same application.
- [Source code](https://github.com/ozzby1/upscale): Public source, model conversion and automated browser tests.

## Capabilities and limits

- Illustration (default): Real-ESRGAN model for drawings and graphic artwork.
- Photo: Real-ESRGAN general x4v3 with adjustable noise reduction. Can be demanding on CPU.
- Compare models on a central crop before processing the whole image.
- Input: JPG, PNG or WebP; up to 20 MB, 12 megapixels and 12,000 pixels on either side per image.
- Batch: up to 10 images and 100 MB total; download results in a ZIP.
- Output: PNG or JPEG. PNG can retain transparency; JPEG uses a white background. Output dimensions and memory limits depend on the device, with a desktop maximum of 8,192 × 8,192 pixels (67.1 MP). Devices reporting at most 4 GB of memory retain a 24 MP limit; iOS/iPadOS retain a 16.7 MP limit.
- In scale mode, 2× or 4× changes pixel dimensions; DPI alone changes print-size metadata. In print-format mode, paper size and DPI determine the target pixel dimensions, with automatic AI scaling followed by resampling to fit the original aspect ratio.
- Installable web app. Offline use requires the app and the assets for the selected model to have been downloaded and retained by the browser; installation alone does not download every model.
- Runtime depends on image size, selected model, device memory and available browser acceleration. CPU processing can take minutes. There is no guaranteed processing time or unlimited image size.
- AI estimates detail and may alter textures, faces or text. It cannot guarantee recovery of missing original detail. Check results at 100% before printing or using them for factual purposes.
